map.视频文件多大？输入分辨率、帧率、时长与码率估算文件大小，或按目标文件大小反推建议: How big is a video file? Input resolution, fps, duration and bitrate to estimate file size, or derive a recommended bitrate from a target size.
map.计算视频码率与预估文件体积。: Compute video bitrate and estimate file size.

map.为什么估算和实际差很多？: Why does the estimate differ a lot from reality?
map.三点原因：一是多数编码使用可变码率（VBR），实际平均码率随画面复杂度波动，与设: Three reasons: first, most encoders use variable bitrate (VBR), so the actual average varies with scene complexity, differing from the target; second, the audio track also takes space, and ignoring it underestimates; third, the container and metadata add overhead. So treat the estimate as a magnitude reference; trust the actual encode for precise values.
